summary: A comprehensive C#/.NET experimentation workspace featuring web applications, desktop GUIs, a custom 3D graphics engine, and object-oriented design patterns.
key_features: Interactive Blazor Server web apps with modern minimal hosting
Custom 3D software rendering engine with vector math and camera controls
OpenTK-powered graphics application with fixed-timestep game loop
Extensible OOP banking system with transaction management
achievements: Engineered a foundational software 3D rendering pipeline from scratch using WinForms GDI+, implementing custom vector algebra, camera transforms, and polygon rasterization without hardware acceleration. Designed a robust OOP banking architecture with immutable transaction models, inheritance, and extensible month-end processing. Integrated OpenTK for immediate mode OpenGL rendering with a fixed-timestep game loop and file-based polygon parsing. Configured modern ASP.NET Core Blazor Server applications with component routing, HTTPS redirection, and environment-aware error handling.
